cover.title: Freakonomics
cover.author: Steven D. Levitt & Stephen J. Dubner

segments.text: One house on your street keeps a loaded gun in a drawer. The other has a pool out back. Which is more likely to kill your child?
It's the pool. By about a hundred to one. Roughly one child drowns for every eleven thousand backyard pools.
It's one gun death for every million-plus guns. The thing that scares you and the thing that's dangerous are rarely the same.
We fear the scary story, the gun, the shark, and walk past the quiet risks that actually take kids. Fear the odds, not the image.
